messages:
Riley (Eng): Need help with an expense. Stayed at a small hotel in Berlin; corpcard charged €276.50 but the hotel sent two PDFs: one invoice with VAT line and a separate receipt showing the bank charged in USD after FX with a $5 foreign fee. Booking was approved by my manager in email. How should I submit so VAT gets reclaimed and GL splits between client and personal meals?
Noah (Finance): Two parts: VAT reclaim (we can reclaim VAT on business lodging if we have a VAT invoice with seller VAT reg number) + allocation for personal meals. Do the vendor PDFs include a VAT number and an itemized VAT line?
Riley (Eng): Invoice A: "Hotel Linden, VAT-DE123456789, Room €230.00, VAT 19% €43.70, Total €273.70". Receipt B: credit-card slip shows USD 295.20 and a bank FX fee $5.30. I uploaded both: https://files.redwood/hotel/linden_invoice_2195.pdf and https://files.redwood/hotel/linden_card_2195.pdf
Zoe (People Ops): Manager approval? Also did you pay any portion personally (meals etc)? Per-diem rules apply for incidental meals on travel days if not included in lodging.
Riley (Eng): Manager approval is in email thread (cc'd). I paid for a dinner once, €28.50 personal; everything else on corpcard.
ExpenseBot: :warning: Expense flagged  foreign-fee + multi-currency reconciliation required. REF: VAT-RECLAIM-2195
Noah (Finance): Filing steps: 1) Submit in Expensify under Lodging. 2) Attach both PDFs + manager approval email screenshot. 3) In notes include: vendor VAT reg number, EUR invoice totals, bank-USD total and FX fee. 4) Add line item to split personal meal: subtract €28.50 and mark that amount as personal (attach receipt). 5) We will code lodging to GL 6100-Travel-Lodging (EUR gross) and record FX/bank fee to GL 6570-BankFees as USD amount. VAT reclaim request will be processed once we confirm VAT invoice matches vendor VAT reg number.
Zoe (People Ops): For the personal €28.50, submit as "Employee personal expense - travel meal" and note it should be deducted from total reimbursement. If you want us to adjust reimbursement before payout say "deduct personal meal €28.50" in notes.
Riley (Eng): Submitted: https://expensify.com/receipt/RE-241900  included attachments and note: "Deduct personal meal €28.50; VAT reg DE123456789; bank charged USD 295.20 + $5.30 FX fee."
Noah (Finance): Got it. I'll mark lodging approved pending VAT validation. If vendor invoice is missing VAT reg or is a mere receipt, we'll need a supplier-provided invoice before reclaim. I'll open VAT-RECLAIM-2195 and follow up.
notes: Attach VAT invoice with seller VAT reg no. and mark personal meal deduction in Expensify notes. Finance will process VAT reclaim once validated.
